info.name: classifier
info.description:
Document Classifier — single-page JPEG/PNG, PDF, .txt and .docx documents scored by OpenCV detectors, deterministic text matching, the open-vocabulary detector, and vision-LLM criteria — called through the LiteLLM pass-through registered in ai/litellm/litellm_config.yaml (`pass_through_endpoints` → `/v1/classifier` → `http://classifier:8000`, `include_subpath: true`, methods GET/POST/DELETE, `forward_headers: true`). Every request is authenticated with a Bearer token from a LiteLLM virtual key: set the collection variables `litellm` (e.g. http://localhost:4001) and `virtual master key` (an sk-… key from the LiteLLM Admin UI → Virtual Keys) — every request inherits them via collection-level auth. See ai/classifier/API.md for the full reference and ai/litellm/LITELLM.md for issuing keys.

Direct base URL (bypassing LiteLLM, only inside ai_shared or when PORT_CLASSIFIER is published): http://classifier:8000 or http://<host>:${PORT_CLASSIFIER} — no auth there.

ONE analysis endpoint: POST /assess, as JSON (`{document: {type: base64|url|text, data}, criteria}`) or multipart (`file` or `text`, plus `criteria`). `/locate` and `/assess/compare` were removed (404); `/locate`'s job is `score: false` on a criterion. A criterion is `{name, type, weight, depends_on, score, options}` with the type-specific settings in `options` — GET /criterion-types has each type's schema, defaults and caps. Documents are single-page; a multi-page PDF is a 400.

Async-job pattern: POST /assess returns 202 with `{job_id, phase: "pending"}`; poll GET /jobs/:jobId until `phase` is `completed` or `failed`. The SQLite jobs table is the queue: CLASSIFIER_MAX_CONCURRENT (default 4) jobs at once; inside a job CLASSIFIER_MAX_CRITERIA_PER_JOB (2) criteria at once; CLASSIFIER_MAX_LLM_CALLS (4) model calls and CLASSIFIER_OCR_WORKERS (4) OCR passes across the whole process. Copy a `job_id` into the `jobId` collection variable to run the GET/DELETE items.

Artifacts: every job stores regions.json, one text.<key>.json per text layer its criteria used, the page's base image and a manifest; SVG / PNG / preview layers render on first fetch. See the Artifacts folder.

Folders: `Documents` (one request per fixture in unit-tests/classifier/documents/), `Regions` (fixtures chosen for their geometry), `Documents + regions` (the document fixtures again, geometry-focused), `Artifacts` (the four artifact routes). `unit-tests/classifier/regions_report.py` runs the first three as a suite (REGIONS_REPORT.md).

variable.description: LiteLLM base URL. Localhost publish is 4001 (PORT_LITELLM); on ai_shared it's http://litellm:4000; behind cloudflared it's https://your-litellm-host.

LiteLLM virtual key (Admin UI → Virtual Keys, or /key/generate API). Scope the key to allow the /v1/classifier pass-through — most keys created for chat models already do. Sent as `Authorization: Bearer {{virtual master key}}` by the collection-level auth, then forwarded to the classifier by LiteLLM because the pass-through has `forward_headers: true`.

job_id returned by POST /assess. Fill in after submitting to run GET /jobs/:jobId, DELETE /jobs/:jobId, and every request in the Artifacts folder. `phase` values progress staging → pending → processing → completed | failed.

A file name in the job's artifact directory — see GET /jobs/:jobId/artifacts for the list. Written at job time: `regions.json`, `manifest.json`, `p0.base.jpg` (page with an image), and one `text.<key>.json` per distinct text layer the criteria used (`text.auto.json`, `text.always.json`, `text.never.json`). Rendered on FIRST FETCH and then cached: `p0.svg`, `p0.layer.png`, `p0.preview.jpg`, and per criterion `p0.<slug>.svg` / `.layer.png` / `.preview.jpg`. Always available as a view: `text.<key>.txt` (the layer's text, plain).

Base64 of unit-tests/classifier/documents/invoice_native.pdf, WITHOUT a data: prefix, for the JSON-body items. Fill it once: `base64 -w0 unit-tests/classifier/documents/invoice_native.pdf` (macOS: `base64 -i … | tr -d '\n'`; PowerShell: [Convert]::ToBase64String([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes('…'))) and paste the output into this variable's CURRENT VALUE.

request.description: Liveness check used by the Docker healthcheck. Returns `{"status": "ok"}`. Excluded from the Prometheus request metrics.

Every criterion type's options, for THIS container: `types.<llm|text|cv|detector>` carries `options_schema` (JSON schema generated from the same pydantic model POST /assess validates against — `additionalProperties: false`, so an unknown key is a 400), `defaults` (resolved: `text.pattern` shows `<name>` because it defaults to the criterion name; `cv.fallback` is `detector` when DETECTOR_URL is configured, else `llm`) and `caps` (server limits a request may not exceed, e.g. `llm.max_attempts` = CLASSIFIER_LLM_BBOX_MAX_ATTEMPTS). Also `shared_fields` (name, type, weight, depends_on, score) and `detector_configured`. No errors. See API.md § `GET /criterion-types`.

Every `options.hint` value an `llm` criterion may carry (`quality`, `presence`, `auto`) and the rubric text the model is given for each — the table is `config.HINT_RUBRICS`, verbatim. A `cv` criterion that falls back to the llm uses `auto`. No errors. See API.md § `GET /hints`.

Every registered OpenCV detector name, grouped by the function behind it — the names a `type: "cv"` criterion is matched against (exact, then difflib at CV_NAME_FUZZY_CUTOFF 0.8). A name that matches none uses the criterion's `options.fallback`. Returns `{detectors: [{function, names}], total_names}`. No errors.

What this container accepts and how it is handled right now: the four kinds (image, pdf — single-page only, txt, docx), the refused legacy .doc, the accepted inputs (JSON base64 | url | text; multipart file | text), the text-match modes, the live OCR status (`ocr.available` loads the engine to answer honestly), the limits (`max_pages: 1`, render DPI, the LLM text budget, and the four concurrency limits: jobs, criteria per job, model calls, OCR passes), and the regions block (always stored; layers render on first fetch; the llm box-loop bounds; the live detector status). No errors.

formdata.description: The document: JPEG, PNG, single-page PDF, .txt or .docx. The kind is detected from the bytes (common.documents.detect_kind), never from the filename or Content-Type. The `src` points at a repo fixture — re-select the file if your Postman working directory differs. The legacy part name `image` is also accepted.
JSON array of criterion objects — the same shape the JSON body's `criteria` takes. See GET /criterion-types.

request.description:
Submit an assessment job — the one analysis endpoint. This item is the multipart form of it: a `file` part (the legacy name `image` is still accepted) OR a `text` field, plus a `criteria` field holding a JSON array. The JSON items below send the SAME request as a body; both are parsed into one `AssessRequest`, so they cannot behave differently. Returns **202 Accepted** with `{"job_id", "phase": "pending"}`; poll GET /jobs/:jobId.

A criterion is `{name, type, weight, depends_on, score, options}` — only the shared fields at the top, everything type-specific in `options` (GET /criterion-types has the schema, defaults and caps):
  llm: `hint` (quality | presence | auto), `boxes` (default false — the bounding-box loop), `max_attempts` (≤ CLASSIFIER_LLM_BBOX_MAX_ATTEMPTS), `ocr` (auto | always | never — the text layer sent with the prompt)
  text: `pattern` (default: the name), `match` (contains | exact | regex | fuzzy), `case_sensitive`, `fuzzy_threshold`, `min_count`, `ocr`
  cv: `fallback` (detector | llm — what answers when no OpenCV detector matches; default detector when DETECTOR_URL is set, else llm)
  detector: `threshold` (default DETECTOR_MIN_SCORE)
`score: false` locates without judging (regions, no score/verdict, excluded from the weighting) — /locate's old job. `depends_on` names another SCORED criterion that must PASS first; until then the dependant is not evaluated at all, and if it does not pass the dependant is SKIPPED with no model call.

Every criterion is its own unit of work: one `llm` criterion = one model call; up to CLASSIFIER_MAX_CRITERIA_PER_JOB run at once; model calls across all jobs are bounded by CLASSIFIER_MAX_LLM_CALLS and OCR passes by CLASSIFIER_OCR_WORKERS. OCR is memoised by settings — criteria with the same `ocr` share one pass. A criterion that fails (model down, unparseable answer, detector outage) gets `status: "error"` alone; the job still completes.

**Errors (400 at submit, nothing queued):** unknown / mistyped / over-cap option (named, e.g. `criteria.0: options.max_attempts: max_attempts 9 exceeds this server's cap…`), an old top-level key (`hint`, `pattern`, … — 'moved into options'), an invalid regex, duplicate names, unknown `depends_on`, a dependency on a `score: false` criterion, a dependency cycle, `score: false` on a criterion that cannot produce geometry or on a .txt/.docx, a `detector` criterion when DETECTOR_URL is unset, a removed form field (`ocr`, `regions`), both or neither of `file`/`text`, an unsupported kind (legacy .doc → convert to .docx), and **a PDF with more than one page** (`only single-page PDFs are supported (this one has N pages)`, read without rendering). **415** for a Content-Type that is neither JSON nor multipart. **500** if the payload could not be persisted. `/locate` and `/assess/compare` no longer exist and answer 404.

Result shape (GET /jobs/:jobId → `result`, `schema_version: 2`):
  `{schema_version, document_info, assessment: {overall_score, overall_verdict, complete, weighted_score_breakdown, per_criterion_scores}, verdict, page_geometry, artifacts}`
Every entry of `per_criterion_scores` has the SAME keys: `status` (ok | error | skipped), `type`, `method` (the path that answered — a cv criterion with no OpenCV detector reports its fallback's), `scored`, `score`, `verdict`, `confidence`, `reason`, `detail`, `regions` (inline, capped at CLASSIFIER_INLINE_REGIONS_MAX with `regions_truncated`), `artifacts` (layer URLs for this criterion, plus `artifacts.text` — the link to the text layer it searched or was prompted with), `localization` (llm criteria: the enforcement loop's record, the empty shape when it did not run; null otherwise), `options_used` (options after defaults and caps), and `error` (why, when status is error).
`complete` is false when any scored criterion errored; `overall_score` / `overall_verdict` are then null and the partial score is in `weighted_score_breakdown` (`partial: true`). `score: false`, skipped and errored criteria never count toward the score.

See API.md § `POST /assess`.

The same request as the multipart POST /assess, as a JSON body: `{"document": {"type": "base64", "data": "…", "filename": "…"}, "criteria": [...]}`. `filename` is optional and only recorded in `document_info`. Fill the `invoice_native_b64` collection variable first (see its description). Returns 202 with a job_id. Same errors as POST /assess, plus 400 for invalid base64 or a body that is not a JSON object. See API.md § `POST /assess`.

`document.type: "url"` — the service fetches the URL AT SUBMIT (the single-page check needs the bytes), after the SSRF check (common.net: private, loopback and link-local addresses are refused). Returns 202. **400** for a blocked or unresolvable URL, **502** when the fetch fails, plus every POST /assess 400. Replace the example URL with a real document.

`document.type: "text"` — the document IS the string, treated as a .txt (UTF-8). No page image, so `cv` / `detector` criteria are SKIPPED, `score: false` is refused, and the llm prompt is text-only. `document_info.filename` is `inline.txt`. Returns 202. Errors as POST /assess.

formdata.value: NOTICE TO OWNER — Under Florida law, those who work on your property…
formdata.description: Inline text, treated as a .txt document. Send this OR a `file` part, not both.
JSON array of criterion objects — the same shape the JSON body's `criteria` takes. See GET /criterion-types.

request.description: The multipart spelling of inline text: a `text` form field instead of a `file` part. Parsed into the same AssessRequest as the JSON `type: "text"` document, so the two produce identical results. Returns 202. **400** when both `text` and `file` are sent, or neither.

List jobs, newest first (common.jobs.router). Query `phase` filters by phase, `limit` (default 50) caps the page. Each row is `{job_id, phase, created_at, updated_at, elapsed_seconds, metadata: {type, request_id}, result, error}` — `metadata.type` is always `assess` (rows queued by an older container may say `compare` / `locate`; those fail with a message naming the removed type). Results can be large — prefer GET /jobs/:jobId.

variable.description: job_id returned by POST /assess (202 body). Paste it here, or set the collection variable `jobId`.

request.description:
Poll one job. `phase` progresses staging → pending → processing → completed | failed. When `completed`, `result` is the assessment:

Result shape (GET /jobs/:jobId → `result`, `schema_version: 2`):
  `{schema_version, document_info, assessment: {overall_score, overall_verdict, complete, weighted_score_breakdown, per_criterion_scores}, verdict, page_geometry, artifacts}`
Every entry of `per_criterion_scores` has the SAME keys: `status` (ok | error | skipped), `type`, `method` (the path that answered — a cv criterion with no OpenCV detector reports its fallback's), `scored`, `score`, `verdict`, `confidence`, `reason`, `detail`, `regions` (inline, capped at CLASSIFIER_INLINE_REGIONS_MAX with `regions_truncated`), `artifacts` (layer URLs for this criterion, plus `artifacts.text` — the link to the text layer it searched or was prompted with), `localization` (llm criteria: the enforcement loop's record, the empty shape when it did not run; null otherwise), `options_used` (options after defaults and caps), and `error` (why, when status is error).
`complete` is false when any scored criterion errored; `overall_score` / `overall_verdict` are then null and the partial score is in `weighted_score_breakdown` (`partial: true`). `score: false`, skipped and errored criteria never count toward the score.

A model outage does NOT fail the job — it fails the criterion (`status: "error"`) and the job completes with `complete: false`. `failed` means the job itself could not run (a thumbnail-sized image, an undecodable file, a payload from an older container). **404** for an unknown job id. See API.md § `GET /jobs/{job_id}`.

variable.description: job_id returned by POST /assess (202 body). Paste it here, or set the collection variable `jobId`.

request.description: Delete the job row AND its artifact directory (the router's `on_delete` hook removes the directory first, so no files are left that nothing points at — the `text.<key>.json` layers go with it). **404** for an unknown job id. A running job is not interrupted. See API.md § `DELETE /jobs/{job_id}`.

item.name: Documents
item.description: One ready-to-run POST /assess per fixture in unit-tests/classifier/documents/ — a native PDF, a scanned PDF (and a never-vs-always OCR pair), a .txt, a .docx, a well and a badly photographed letter, and the two refusals (a legacy .doc and a two-page PDF). Each carries criteria tailored to its fixture and states the expected outcome; the folder's README.md holds the same table plus curl equivalents. Regenerate the fixtures with `uv run --package classifier python unit-tests/classifier/documents/make_fixtures.py`. Postman resolves each `src` relative to its working directory — re-select the file if it cannot find it.

item.name: Artifacts
item.description: The four artifact routes, plus the text-layer view. Every job writes an artifact directory (regions.json, text.<key>.json per text layer, the base image, manifest.json); layers render on first fetch. Set `jobId` (and `artifactName` for the file route) first.

variable.description: job_id returned by POST /assess (202 body). Paste it here, or set the collection variable `jobId`.

request.description: The manifest: `{job_id, created_at, expires_at, options, criteria, page_geometry, files, total_bytes, dropped, notes, zip_url}`. `files` is what is on disk NOW, each with its `url` — layers appear once they have been fetched (they render on first fetch). `criteria` maps each criterion name to its `slug`, region `count`, `sources`, and `text_layer` (the key of the `text.<key>.json` it used, or null). Every job writes a directory, so **404** means the job is unknown or has not finished; **410** means it had artifacts and the TTL sweeper or a DELETE removed them. See API.md § `GET /jobs/{job_id}/artifacts`.

query.description: Criterion SLUG (not name), from the manifest's `criteria` map or a result's `artifacts.slug`. Repeatable. Filters the render to that criterion's regions. An unknown slug is a 400.
Comma list of `cv`, `ocr`, `pdf-text`, `llm`, `detector`. Only regions from those sources are drawn.
LLM criteria only: the box from enforcement-loop attempt N, accepted or not — how a REJECTED box is viewed on its own. `artifacts.attempts[]` in the result carries these URLs ready-made.
LLM criteria only. `true` (the default when no `attempt` is given) keeps the accepted attempt; `false` keeps the rejected ones.

variable.description: job_id returned by POST /assess (202 body). Paste it here, or set the collection variable `jobId`.

A file name in the job's artifact directory — see GET /jobs/:jobId/artifacts for the list. Written at job time: `regions.json`, `manifest.json`, `p0.base.jpg` (page with an image), and one `text.<key>.json` per distinct text layer the criteria used (`text.auto.json`, `text.always.json`, `text.never.json`). Rendered on FIRST FETCH and then cached: `p0.svg`, `p0.layer.png`, `p0.preview.jpg`, and per criterion `p0.<slug>.svg` / `.layer.png` / `.preview.jpg`. Always available as a view: `text.<key>.txt` (the layer's text, plain).

request.description:
Stream one file with its content type (`application/json`, `image/svg+xml`, `image/png`, `image/jpeg`, `text/plain; charset=utf-8`).

* A file that exists is streamed as-is.
* A LAYER that does not exist yet — `p0.svg`, `p0.layer.png`, `p0.preview.jpg`, or per criterion `p0.<slug>.svg|layer.png|preview.jpg` — is rendered from `regions.json` now and cached into the directory (counting against CLASSIFIER_ARTIFACT_MAX_BYTES).
* With any query filter (`criterion`, `source`, `attempt`, `accepted`) `regions.json` or a combined `p0.*` layer is re-rendered for that subset by the same renderer; only the plain single-criterion view is cached (as `p0.<slug>.<suffix>`), so the filtered and stored views can never disagree.
* `text.<key>.txt` returns the `text` field of `text.<key>.json` as plain text.

**Errors:** 400 for an unsafe name, an unknown slug, or a filter on a file that is not regions.json / a combined layer; 404 for an unknown or unfinished job, a missing file that is not a layer, a layer on a document with no page image (.txt/.docx), or a preview whose base image the byte cap dropped; 410 when the directory was swept or deleted. See API.md § `GET /jobs/{job_id}/artifacts/{name}`.

item.name: GET /jobs/:jobId/artifacts/:artifactName — text.auto.json (the text a criterion searched)

variable.description: job_id returned by POST /assess (202 body). Paste it here, or set the collection variable `jobId`.
`text.<key>.json` — the key is in each text/llm criterion's `artifacts.text.key` (and the manifest's `criteria.<name>.text_layer`). `text.<key>.txt` for plain text.

request.description:
The exact text a `text` criterion searched (and an `llm` criterion was sent), as the job stored it. One file per distinct text layer the job produced, named by its settings key — `auto`, `always`, `never` (a future non-default OCR setting adds a hash: `auto-1a2b3c4d`) — and shared by every criterion that used those settings. Each criterion's result links its own: `artifacts.text = {key, url, source, chars}`, and `options_used.ocr` agrees with the key.

Body: `{key, settings: {mode, min_native_chars, engine}, source: native|ocr|none, engine: "rapidocr"|null, chars, confidence, text, lines: [{text, polygon, confidence}]}`. `text` is byte-for-byte the string `match_text` searched, so a failed match can be diagnosed from this file alone. `lines` are the OCR lines with polygons in ORIGINAL page pixels; empty for native text (.txt, .docx, and native PDF text, whose line geometry is not recorded).

Set `artifactName` to `text.auto.txt` for the same text as `text/plain; charset=utf-8`. Written for every job whose criteria read text, native or OCR'd; never dropped by the byte cap; deleted with the job. **404** when the job has no layer by that key.

variable.description: job_id returned by POST /assess (202 body). Paste it here, or set the collection variable `jobId`.

request.description: Every file currently in the directory, streamed as one zip (`application/zip`, `Content-Disposition: attachment`). Built from what is on disk, so layers that were never fetched are not in it — fetch them first if you want them. **404** / **410** as for the manifest.

variable.description: job_id returned by POST /assess (202 body). Paste it here, or set the collection variable `jobId`.

request.description: Free the disk and keep the job row: removes the whole artifact directory (regions.json, text layers, base image, cached layers). **204** on success; **404** for an unknown job or one with no directory. Afterwards the artifact routes answer **410**. The inline regions in the result survive.

item.name: Regions
item.description: Fixtures chosen for their geometry (unit-tests/classifier/regions/README.md): OpenCV mask polygons, merged text blocks, OCR line polygons, native-PDF rectangles, the detector, `score: false`, and the LLM enforcement loop. Regions are always stored; fetch the layers from `result.artifacts.layers` (rendered on first fetch).

request.description: What /locate used to do. Both criteria have `score: false`: they run exactly as scored ones and return their regions, but `score` / `verdict` / `confidence` are null and they are excluded from the weighting — so `overall_score` and `verdict` are null and `weighted_score_breakdown` is null. request.description: The loop runs per criterion with `options.boxes: true`: ask for a box on a labelled 0-1000 grid → validate → refine on a zoomed crop → verify the crop alone → retry with the rejection as feedback, up to `options.max_attempts` (never more than CLASSIFIER_LLM_BBOX_MAX_ATTEMPTS). Gated on the presence score (≥ 7) and hint presence/auto — `image sharpness` (quality) is never boxed. Model-dependent; the invariants: identical score/verdict with `boxes` off, every attempt in `localization.attempts` and in `regions` (`attrs.accepted`), `a parked car` ≤ 2 attempts, and `artifacts.attempts[n].svg` renders that attempt. Every call counts against CLASSIFIER_MAX_LLM_CALLS.
